Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
SUBJECT:  AUDIO RECORDING OF EARNINGS CALL HELD ON OCTOBER 23, 2026 
 
This is in furtherance to our letter dated October 19, 2026, w.r.t the Earnings Call intimation 
for the financial results with the Institutional investors/ analysts. 
 
In terms of Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the earnings call has been 
uploaded on the website of the Company at www.jindalsteel.in/performance-highlights. 
 
You are requested to take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully,
